description: Header file defining the MessageUnit class and related classes for message buffer management, configuration, and IPC communication within the Thunder::Messaging namespace.

classes.name: MessageUnit
classes.description: Singleton class managing message buffers, configuration, and IPC communication for messaging system.

classes.name: MessageUnit::Buffer
classes.description: Shared memory buffer for message data.

classes.name: MessageUnit::Control
classes.description: Represents the state (enabled/disabled) of a message category/module.

classes.name: MessageUnit::Settings
classes.description: Holds configuration settings for message dispatching, including JSON config parsing and environment variable management.

classes.name: MessageUnit::Settings::Config
classes.description: JSON-based configuration structure for message dispatcher settings.

classes.name: MessageUnit::Client
classes.description: Client interface for message data buffer IPC communication.

classes.name: MessageUnit::MessageDispatcher
classes.description: Handles IPC message dispatching and metadata management.

classes.name: MessageUnit::MetaDataBuffer
classes.description: IPC channel for metadata exchange, handling protocol messages.

methods.name: MessageUnit::Open
methods.description: Opens message buffers with specified configuration.

methods.name: MessageUnit::Close
methods.description: Closes message buffers and IPC channels.

methods.name: MessageUnit::Default
methods.description: Checks if a metadata control is enabled by default.

methods.name: MessageUnit::Push
methods.description: Pushes a message into the message system.

methods.name: MessageUnit::Update
methods.description: Updates message control settings based on metadata.
